definition_en: only just, or almost not
core_image: 一只手刚够到架子最边沿的杯子
scene: 灯突然灭了，屋里一片黑。I could barely see the road ahead.
sceneCN: 这里 barely 是「几乎不」（第 1 个义项：表示程度极低，差一点就不能）；句意是我几乎看不清前面的路。

derivatives.zh: 基础词，义为「赤裸的；光秃的」，barely 由其加 -ly 构成

senses.title: Almost not
senses.definition: only just, in a way that is almost not true
senses.definitionCN: 只差一点就不能，程度极低
senses.example: I could barely see the road ahead.
senses.exampleCN: 我几乎看不清前面的路。
senses.why: Barely is bare plus -ly, and bare means 'nothing extra', so barely marks a point with nothing to spare.
senses.whyCN: barely 是 bare 加 -ly，而 bare 意为「没有多余」，所以 barely 标记的是毫无余量的那一点。

senses.title: Only just
senses.definition: by only a small amount or margin
senses.definitionCN: 只差很小的量或幅度
senses.example: We had barely enough money for the bus.
senses.exampleCN: 我们的钱勉强够坐公交。
senses.why: When a supply has no surplus, just enough is barely enough, which gives the sense of a narrow margin.
senses.whyCN: 当供给没有剩余时，刚好够就等于勉强够，于是产生「只差一点」的含义。

intro.en: Barely is the adverb built on the old word bare.
intro.cn: barely 是建在古词 bare 上的副词。

items.en: baer meant 'uncovered'.
bar kept the sense of having nothing extra.
items.cn: bar 保留了「没有多余」的含义。

items.en: barely meant 'in a bare way'.
items.cn: barely 意为「以毫无多余的方式」。

items.en: barely came to mean almost not at all.
barely is common with enough and see.
items.cn: 如今 barely 常与 enough、see 搭配。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bare- shape; the near-meaning group gives other words for a small margin.
note.cn: 形近组与 bare 形似；近义组是表示「差一点」的词。

definition_en: something bought for less than the usual price, an agreement, or to argue about a price
core_image: 摊位上贴着打折标签的一只旧木箱
scene: 周末的集市人声嘈杂。She found a warm coat at a bargain price.
sceneCN: 这里 bargain 是「便宜货」（第 1 个义项：以低于常价买到的物品）；句意是她以很便宜的价格买到一件暖和的外套。

derivatives.zh: 由 bargain 加 -ing 构成，义为「讨价还价」
由 bargain 加 -er 构成，义为「讨价还价的人」

senses.title: Something cheap
senses.definition: something bought for less than its usual price
senses.definitionCN: 以低于平常价格买到的东西
senses.example: She found a warm coat at a bargain price.
senses.exampleCN: 她以很便宜的价格买到一件暖和的外套。
senses.why: A bargain first meant a deal struck after haggling, and a good deal is one bought cheaply.
senses.whyCN: bargain 起初指讨价还价后达成的交易，划算的交易就是买得便宜的东西。

senses.title: An agreement
senses.definition: an agreement between two sides about what each will do
senses.definitionCN: 双方就各自要做的事达成的约定
senses.example: They struck a bargain over the price.
senses.exampleCN: 他们就价格达成了协议。
senses.why: The oldest sense is the agreement itself, before the word came to praise a low price.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是协议本身，后来这个词才用来称赞低价。

senses.title: To haggle
senses.definition: to argue about a price until both sides agree
senses.definitionCN: 就价格争论直到双方同意
senses.example: He bargained with the seller for ten minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 他和卖家讨价还价了十分钟。
senses.why: The verb came from Old French bargaignier, to haggle, and names the talk that leads to the deal.
senses.whyCN: 动词来自古法语 bargaignier「讨价还价」，指促成交易的那番交谈。

intro.en: Bargain came from a French verb meaning to haggle.
intro.cn: bargain 来自一个表示「讨价还价」的法语动词。

barghaigne meant 'a deal'.

items.cn: 如今 bargain hunt 是常见说法。

core_image: 老树干上裂开的粗糙树皮
scene: 院子里的狗突然竖起耳朵。A dog barked at the gate.

senses.example: The bark of the old tree was deeply cracked.

senses.whyCN: 这个义项来自古诺斯语 borkr，与狗叫声毫无关系。

senses.title: A dog's sound
senses.definition: the short loud sound a dog makes
senses.definitionCN: 狗发出的短促而响亮的声音
senses.example: A dog barked at the gate.

definition_en: a large round container with curved sides, or to move very fast
core_image: 酒窖里一排弧肚木桶
scene: 酒窖里飘着木头的味道。They rolled the barrel down to the cellar.
sceneCN: 这里 barrel 是「桶」（第 1 个义项：侧面鼓起的圆形大容器）；句意是他们把桶滚进地窖。

derivatives.zh: 由 barrel 加 -ful 构成，义为「一桶之量」

senses.title: A round container
senses.definition: a large round container with a flat top and bottom and curved sides
senses.definitionCN: 上下平、侧面鼓起的圆形大容器
senses.example: They rolled the barrel down to the cellar.
senses.why: Barrel came from Old French baril, a cask, and its curved wooden staves make it easy to roll.
senses.whyCN: barrel 来自古法语 baril「木桶」，弧形木板使它便于滚动。

senses.why: Because the container was a standard size, its name became a unit of measure.
senses.whyCN: 因为容器容量固定，它的名称就成了计量单位。

senses.why: A rolling barrel gathers speed, so the verb pictures fast, unchecked movement.
senses.whyCN: 滚动的木桶会越滚越快，所以动词描绘的是快速而失控的运动。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 be 想成一根看不见的线，把主语和它的样子连在一起。

root: 由古英语 beon「存在」、wesan「停留」与 eom「是」等词根合并而成，形成英语中最不规则的动词，核心义为「是、存在、成为」。

sensesIntro.en: One small verb links, exists and becomes.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个小小的动词，承担「是、存在、成为」三种作用。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a steady reflection in a mirror.
core.cn: 核心意象：镜中稳定的倒影。

intro.en: Be takes -ing and -en to form being and been.
intro.cn: be 加 -ing 与 -en 构成 being 与 been。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the forms come from Old English.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，各形式来自古英语。
